name: Power-feed robustness (single-via SPOF)
description: Advisory (needs via-bearing design data): a power or ground net that crosses layers through a single via is a current + reliability single-point-of-failure. Not_applicable without net via data (e.g. from a KiCad board; IPC-D-356 carries no vias).
what_it_measures: Count of power/ground nets that span multiple layers through exactly one via.
